points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: All eight selected production packages are present, and restart_io.cpp saves actual state/time/step; transient restart reconstructs missing prior BDF level and resumes with backward Euler.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Snapshot records explicit examiner checks. Independently ran clean build and 8 bounded NACA/unit tests; these structural/method checks do not replace Re200 production validation.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Seven selected steady runs have b350651 metadata; M2 inviscid reports 2.55-order force plateau and M015 laminar lift drifts in last400. Re200 reaches t300 with reported target counts but exact production binary remains unbound.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 selected Cd2.018 and Re200 raw Cd1.216–1.259/Cl±0.513 over t>=100 are plausible with moderate coarse-mesh limitations; St reported0.182, FFT diagnostic0.17999.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Accepted 52-page report contains readable steady histories, fields and Re200 wake/force figure; startup spike compresses late Re200 drag so the explicit late lift/drag criterion is unmet.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: The report gives extensive case tables, fields, limitations and plateau discussion. report.tex:372–380 states both positivity events are counted per step, but Re200 production binary lacked fallback telemetry; docs/binary_provenance.md qualifies the gap. Its stated M2 fallback count 326 differs from selected metadata 595.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Reports/figures have manifest links. Steady cases report revision b350651, whereas Re200 revision is null and contestant binary_provenance.md says pre-15:05 build at a628093 or earlier; the separate 100-step single-rank fallback probe does not cover full 4-rank transient.

disqualification_flags.flag: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
